Name: smallcopper's hairs for fashion sense
Author: smallcopper
Description:
soooo i'm already back again with my second mod ever, lmao. this one i also made for myself but have also decided to share :)

it adds six new hairstyles for fashion sense, all colourable/varied etc. 


instructions for download - unzip the file, drop it in your stardew/mods folder then just run the game and u should be good to go. also requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]fashion sense[/url] to work! 


hope you enjoy!!
